points.title: Globalize profile-edit location model and labels
points.evidence: 2026-09-27 audit: edit profile assumes Brazilian UF (2 chars), CEP and address semantics; change() uppercases/truncates uf to 2 chars. This structurally constrains worldwide profiles.

points.title: Make avatar media itself keyboard/click accessible for replacement
points.evidence: 2026-09-27 audit: cover media is a button opening hidden picker, but avatar preview is a non-interactive div followed by file input; requirement says avatar and cover must be clickable.
